death-black.$description: Death Black — Primary text, core UI backgrounds, filled buttons. Establishes the dominant, aggressive tone.

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Text on dark backgrounds, primary page backgrounds.

off-black.$description: Off-Black — Body copy on light backgrounds, secondary UI elements.

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Product grid background, subtle dividers.

gravel-gray.$description: Gravel Gray — Secondary text, disabled states, placeholder text.

light-ash.$description: Light Ash — Alternative light background color for section differentiation.

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Hover states on dark elements.

input-border.$description: Input Border — Default border color for text input fields.

polished-gold.$description: Polished Gold — Accents, special links, logotype details — a premium, metallic highlight against the stark monochrome.

antique-gold.$description: Antique Gold — Hover state for gold accents, secondary logotype details.

acumin-pro.$description: The single, dominant typeface used for everything from massive uppercase headlines to body copy. Its clean, geometric form provides a brutalist, no-nonsense foundation. Extensive use of uppercase at 700 weight for headings is the brand's signature voice.

acumin-pro-condensed.$description: Used sparingly for subtitles and calorie counts where horizontal space is limited. Maintains the core Acumin feel in a more compact format.
